source_claim: AlphaEvolve-scale engineering evidence should be backed by repeatable validation over code, documentation, paper evidence, packaging, and supported runtime environments
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve has a path-scoped GitHub Actions workflow with manual dispatch, push/pull_request path filters, a secret scan job, Python 3.11/3.12 Ubuntu unit jobs, an optional credential-gated integration job, and unit tests that check the workflow shape. It does not claim a CI paper-manifest job, semantic documentation-claim verification, wheel/sdist CI smoke tests, cross-platform CI coverage, branch policy, or notification policy.
